tests.name: C-10: OS reconstruction group-independence
tests.details:
OS reconstruction chain group-independence:
  OS reconstruction requires only OS0-OS4: OS axioms are group-independent structural properties PASS
  Spectral gap extraction uses spectral theorem: Spectral theorem is a Hilbert space result, no group input PASS
  Exponential clustering requires only mu_min > 0: mu_min > 0 proven for all G in §4.6 PASS
  Reflection positivity on Z^4 holds for any compact G: Wilson action is RP for any compact G (Seiler 1982) PASS
  Contradiction argument (§4.8) is group-independent: Uses only spectral decomposition and decay rate PASS
